items.passage: We expect our revenue to continue to grow by around 10% to 15% in the coming year.

However, in FY'26, we should witness a higher growth rate of at least 20% to 25%, as new orders are expected to be received in FY'25, which will start generating revenue in FY'26, post the initial mobilization phase of 6 to 9 months in the current year.
See, what we are looking at is our order book to reach around INR25,000 crores by end of FY'25, so post execution of this year.
We expect to maintain our margins of around 14%, which is there.
As per our current estimate, it will be around 20%.

Payal Lad: Okay. So like do you anticipate your overall tunnelling order book percentage to increase from year on? Or would it continue to remain in the range of 10% to 11%?
Management: So it may be there in the range of 10% to 15%.

Jay Shah: Okay, INR4,000 crores. So what is the company's projected top line and bottom line growth for the upcoming quarters then?
Management: So on a full year basis, we expect 10% to 15% growth in the top line. And bottom line, I mean, around same percentage we should be able to maintain.
